displayName: TikTok: post & schedule videos and photo carousels (1Social)
description: Post to TikTok and schedule TikTok videos and photo carousels from OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code or Codex. Publishes to the user's own TikTok account via the 1Social MCP server (OAuth, no API key), checks the TikTok caption and media-format rules first, schedules up to 30 days ahead and returns a delivery receipt. Use to post or schedule on TikTok, publish a video or photos, plan TikTok content, or check, edit or delete TikTok posts.
